Run the daily morning triage and focus planning for Hwasung (hwasungmars@gmail.com) using the assistant and research skills. Use British English throughout. This run is READ-ONLY for the inbox: never send, archive, label, mark read or delete any email.

1. ASSISTANT BRIEFING: Run Workflow A of the assistant skill: check today's events across the primary calendar (hwasungmars@gmail.com), linked Apple Calendar feed (opnnnoego3kj1shmrcpc57jajpjg19dk@import.calendar.google.com) and Family calendar (family13379542018784707698@group.calendar.google.com). Check active to-dos via gmail_fetch_inbox with query 'label:"Triage/Needs Reply"' and unread inbox messages, plus query 'label:"Triage/Waiting"' for overdue replies.

2. DRAFT REPLIES: For each email that genuinely needs a written reply (limit to 5 most important), first check that no draft already exists by calling gmail_fetch_inbox with query 'in:drafts'. Read the thread with gmail_get_message, then call gmail_reply with mode 'draft' (NEVER 'send') on the latest message. Follow the writing style in preferences.md (British English, informal, concise, sign off 'Best,\n\nHwasung'). Record draft_id.

3. EXECUTIVE READING DOCKET: Run python3 /Users/hwasung_lee/.gemini/config/plugins/research/skills/research/scripts/fetch_papers.py --days 2 --min-upvotes 0 --format json. Screen against breakthrough_rubric.md and keep the top 2 algorithmic breakthroughs with arXiv links and one-sentence summaries. Also digest unread Tier 1 AI newsletters from the inbox (Interconnects essays only, The Batch, Ahead of AI, Deep Learning Focus, Exploring Language Models) received in the last 7 days.

4. CALENDAR FOCUS BLOCK: Find a free 60-minute window between 09:00 and 17:00 with at least 15 minutes of buffer around other events across all 3 calendars (or pipe freebusy into find_slots.py). If an event titled 'Focus Block: Email Replies & Paper Reading' already exists today, update it rather than creating a duplicate. Otherwise create it on the primary calendar (no attendees) with description sections: (a) EMAILS TO REPLY TO (with draft_ids); (b) OTHER ACTIONS; (c) EXECUTIVE READING DOCKET (papers & newsletters).
description: Every day at 6:00 AM (America/Los_Angeles), triages Gmail, stages draft replies (never sends), digests Tier 1 AI newsletters, curates breakthrough papers via the research skill, and books a 1-hour focus block with the briefing in the description.
